normalized_result.value:
Torus is a torus with variable arc and oscillations.
Arc is the angle around the axis.
Cut removes half of the shape.
Oscillate varies the thickness depending on the bubble and rib frequencies.
Bubble Freq is the oscillation rate around the axis.
Rib Freq is the oscillation rate around the tube.
Twist adds twist to the bubbles.
Wave Shape gives a choice for the oscillations.
Ellipse makes the torus elliptical.
Arc Ends allows open or closed ends when the Arc is less than 360 degrees.
Rib Phase moves the ribs around the tube.

Tyrus is a torus with a variety of tread patterns, good for tyres.
Thickness is the tube size; positive for circular, negative for squarer.
Cover is how much of the surface has tread.
Tread is the height of the tread pattern.
Pattern Lat repeats along the shaft.
Pattern Long repeats around the shaft.
Clip Lat and Clip Long clip the top or bottom of the patterns.
Bias shifts the zero point for multiplying the patterns together.
Twist adds a slant to the tread, mirrored if negative.
0T[

Cp Toroid makes copies in a coil around a torus with modulations.
Amplitude is the coil width.
Density adjusts the number and size of copies.
Flatten squashes towards a cylinder if positive or plate if negative.
Twists adds rotation around the coil.
Cycle Freq is the turn rate around the torus.
Mod Freq 1/2 are rates of amplitude modulation.
Mod Phase 1/2 shift the modulation phase between horizontal and vertical components.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles around the torus.
Size Adjust changes the size of copies.
Orient changes orientation of copies in different ways.

Cp Torus makes copies in a torus.
Width is the torus width.
Density adjusts the number and size of copies.
Flatten squashes towards a cylinder if positive or plate if negative.
Size adjusts the size of copies.
Twists adds rotation around the torus.
Pre-rotate changes the orientation of copies.
Orient adjusts orientation to the torus.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Grille Ring makes copies in a grille pattern around a ring.
Width adjusts the grille width.
Orientation rotates between a flat ring and a cylinder.
Density adjusts the number and size of copies.
Size Adjust changes the size of copies.
XY Frequency is the ratio between X and Y oscillation rates.
Wave/Mirror sets the shape of the main curve, with Vertical and Horizontal symmetry options.
Loop Amount adds sine loops to the wave.
Loop Frequency sets the number of vertical loops.
Loop Phase adjusts the phase of the loop oscillations.
Loop Weave sets a rate of interweaving of loops if positive, or toroidal width if negative.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles around the torus.
Twists adds rotation around the coil.

normalized_result.value:
Sphere is a sphere with some warp options having rotational symmetry.
Warp stretches one or both poles depending on Warp Shape.
Waist makes the equator fatter or thinner.
Ovoid stretches into an egg shape.
Sharpness adjusts the ovoid thickness at the top, with a kink if negative.
Bilobe fattens left and right halves.
Shear moves left and right sides vertically.
Shear Bias varies shear curvature vertically.
XZ Curve squeezes or fattens the shape around Y.
Taper X tapers in the X direction, symmetric if negative.
Taper Type sets which axis is tapered.
Taper Shape sets the taper curve.

Ball is a sphere with variable arc and truncation, and several vertical profiles.
Arc sets the sphere's extent around the Y axis.
Flat Top truncates the top of the sphere.
Open removes the inner faces when using Arc or Flat Top.

Point Cloud makes a point cloud, opened from a file.
Point Size sets the relative size for a sphere at each point.
File Colors sets whether to use colors from the file instead of a gradient.
Scaling options set the point cloud to a workable size for the holon scaling to adjust.
Centered automatically centers the point cloud.
File is the filename; currently a .ply or .prt file.
The maximum number of points is currently 20 million.

Squarer makes a circular or spherical shape more or less square or cubic.
The Square X, Y and Z settings adjust the profile around each axix.
Cubize makes a sphere more or less cubic.

Cp Sphere makes copies in a golden spiral around a sphere.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Offset moves the copies radially.
Orient automatically orients each copy away from the center, relative to vertical.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.
Radial Mod varies the radius with a sine wave set by Mod Frequency, negative for Abs Sine.

Holes Spheric cuts rows of holes around a sphere.
Radius sets the hole size.
Density adjusts the number of holes.
Warp changes the hole shape from circular, with choice of two shapes.
Centered has a row at the equator.
Walls adds tunnel walls to the holes.

ClipNClamp displaces points outside a shape by clipping, clamping or a mixture.
Clip/Clamp mixes between the two. Set to 0 to clip, 1 to clamp.
3D displaces towards/away from the origin, rather than a line or plane.
3D has no effect for Shape set to Cube or Sphere.
Shift moves the affected parts in or out. Independent of Amount, and most useful with clamping.
Clamp Inner moves points inside the shape towards clamped values.

Riemann Sphr maps the XY plane to a Riemann sphere, with the origin at the south pole and infinity at the north pole.
Scale is the radius of a circle that maps to the equator.
Thickness is how much the Z position modulates the sphere radius.
South Pole chooses the direction to orient the sphere.

Cube Lattice 1 makes a cubic lattice of rods and balls or cubes. Always has effect.
Ball Size is the size of the corner shapes.
Ball Shape chooses whether corners are spheres or cubes.
Ball Random adds random variation to ball size.
Rod Shape sets the profile of connecting rods.
Rod Size sets the rod thickness.
Mod Shape sets the waveform for rod oscillations.
Mod Amount adds oscillations to the rod thickness.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillations.
Spring adds helical coils to the rods. Negative values make a variable pitch spring.

normalized_result.value:
Cube is a cube with options to deform the faces, edges and corners.
Face Warp extends each face in a pyramid or conic shape.
Face Curve makes the face extension sharper.
Inset is the distance from the edge where Face Warp starts.
Edge Warp extends the edges outside the Inset distance.
Crop Face truncates the face extensions, or inverts them if negative.
Corner Crush truncates the corners.
Face Squeeze narrows face extensions in one direction if positive or into a cross if negative.
Face Choice selects which faces can warp.

RoundCube is a rounded cube with options to deform the faces, edges and corners.
Inset is the distance from edges that is rounded.
Edge expands the rounded edge into a tube.
Split Edges gives each face its own rounded edges.
Face Warp extends each face in a pyramid or conic shape.
Face Curve makes the face extension sharper.
Face Shape sets the shape for Face Warp.
Crop face truncates the face extensions, or inverts them if negative.
When Edge is positive, Edge Crop truncates expanded edges when positive or inverts them if negative.
XY Aspect and Z Aspect change the aspect ratio in each direction, with equal width of edges.

normalized_result.value:
Pipe is a cylinder with optional central hole.
Bevel adds a slope to the end faces.
Cap adds curvature to the end faces.
Fluting adds ridges along the pipe.
Flute Freq is the frequency of the fluting; negative for outside only.
Centered fixes the position at the center instead of one end.
Cap Shape sets the end shape for the Cap parameter.
Cap Bias shifts the center of the cap shape.
Bevel/Cap sets which ends to modify.
Flute Twist twists the fluting around the pipe.

Cylinder is a cylinder on the Z axis with variable arc.
Arc is the angle around the cylinder.
Closed Ends sets which ends have closed surfaces.
Wedge slopes the ends in towards the center.
Spherical adds a spherical curvature to the outside of the cylinder, most useful for short lengths.
Bevel Edges truncates the end edges if positive or rounds them if negative.
Bevel sets which ends to bevel.

Grille Ring makes a grille pattern around a ring.
Width adjusts the grille width.
Thickness sets the width of the tubing.
Orientation rotates between a flat ring and a cylinder.
Wave Shape sets the shape of the main curve.
XY Frequency is the ratio between X and Y oscillation rates.
Mirror gives reflective symmetry choices.
Loop Amount adds sine loops to the wave.
Loop Frequency sets the number of vertical loops.
Loop Phase adjusts the phase of the loop oscillations.
Loop Weave sets a rate of interweaving of tubes if positive, or toroidal width if negative.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles.
Profile sets the shape of the tubing.

Cp Toroid makes copies in a coil around a torus with modulations.
Amplitude is the coil width.
Density adjusts the number and size of copies.
Flatten squashes towards a cylinder if positive or plate if negative.
Twists adds rotation around the coil.
Cycle Freq is the turn rate around the torus.
Mod Freq 1/2 are rates of amplitude modulation.
Mod Phase 1/2 shift the modulation phase between horizontal and vertical components.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles around the torus.
Size Adjust changes the size of copies.
Orient changes orientation of copies in different ways.

Cp Ringstar makes copies in a ring of radial arms.
Num Arms is the number of radial arms.
Num Rings is the number of concentric rings.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Pre-Rotate options change orientation before rotation.
Alt Arms options invert every second arm in specified directions.
Alt Rings options invert every second ring in specified directions.
Rotate X adds rotation of copies around X along the arms.
Twist Z twists the arms around the Z axis.

Mound displaces vertically in a smooth mound, and is also useful for modulating displacement of other metamorphs.
Shape sets the mound outline.
Profile sets the way the slope varies.
Flatten makes a steeper slope with flat top.
Bias moves the whole surface vertically; mostly useful with modulation or Multiply Input.
Multiply Mix blends between adding and multiplying the input.

Seed Group sets a seed point for the group to begin iteration when there are no constructors being iterated. It is useful for pure Julia, Bulb and Quaternion fractals.
Seed Group can be used on any holon in the group (active or not), or on the group itself, but is most convenient to adjust when on the same holon as a fractal metamorph.
The seed point and its iterations can be seen with Shaded Preview off. Adjust the position to move them into the fractal surface. Some fractal shapes need the seed to be in a particular area. Some need Y or Z position to be non-zero.
The Enabled option is a quick way to test the effect.

UVWDisp Z combines input from the UVW color channels of the previous metamorph and displaces in the Z direction.
Channel controls select from the 6 color channels.
Gain controls adjust the amount of each channel.
Functions transform the channels.
Blend 1&2 sets how to combine the first two channels.
Blend 3 sets how to combine with the third channel. Bypass is useful when crossfading Ch1&2.

UVWDisp Sph combines input from the UVW color channels of the previous metamorph and displaces spherically.
Channel controls select from the 6 color channels.
Gain controls adjust the amount of each channel.
Functions transform the channels.
Blend 1&2 sets how to combine the first two channels.
Blend 3 sets how to combine with the third channel. Bypass is useful when crossfading Ch1&2

Ridge displaces vertically in a ridge or valley along the Z axis, and is also useful for modulating displacement of other metamorphs.
Ridge Shape sets the ridge profile.
Wave properties affect oscillation of the ridge.
Mod Effect and Frequency allow sine wave modulation of the height and/or wave, clipped at bottome if Mod Frequency is negative.

Bias moves the whole surface vertically; mostly useful with modulation or Multiply Input.
Multiply Mix blends between adding and multiplying the input.

Sphere is a sphere with some warp options having rotational symmetry.
Warp stretches one or both poles depending on Warp Shape.
Waist makes the equator fatter or thinner.
Ovoid stretches into an egg shape.

Bilobe fattens left and right halves.
Shear moves left and right sides vertically.

XZ Curve squeezes or fattens the shape around Y.
Taper X tapers in the X direction, symmetric if negative.
Taper Type sets which axis is tapered.
Taper Shape sets the taper curve.
